interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to monitor and send CDP/LLDP announcements on.

cdp_enabled.description: Enable CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol) packet transmission.

cdp_mac.description: MAC address to use as source for CDP packets (leave empty or use '00:00:00:00:00:00' for auto).

lldp_enabled.description: Enable LLDP (Link Layer Discovery Protocol) packet transmission.

lldp_mac.description: MAC address to use as source for LLDP packets (leave empty or use '00:00:00:00:00:00' for auto).

vlan_enabled.description: Enable IEEE 802.1Q VLAN discovery via CDP (Cisco-only extension).

vlan_auto.description: Automatically configure trunk VLANs on switch port when VLAN discovery is enabled.

port_desc.description: Format of the port description field sent in announcements. Use 'hostname' or a custom string (e.g., 'switch-port-{{ hostname }}').

tos.description: Type-of-Service (TOS) byte for outgoing packets (0–255). Default (192 = 0xC0) sets IP precedence 6.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical.

pidfile.description: Path to write the process PID file.

chassis_id.description: Override chassis ID (e.g., 'chassis.example.com' or MAC). Leave empty to auto-generate from first interface MAC.
